# On-disk scripts/**/test_*.py excluding _archive
ondisk = []
for root, dirs, fnames in os.walk('scripts'):
    if '_archive' in root:
        continue
    for f in fnames:

            ondisk.append(os.path.join(root, f))
ondisk = sorted(ondisk)
print("on-disk collected test files:", len(ondisk))
missing = [f for f in ondisk if f not in set(files)]

    import ast
    src = open(path).read()
    tree = ast.parse(src)
    n = sum(1 for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name.startswith('test_'))
    return n
